decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 3 - 3.	The position, type and manner of installation of all services, antenna and related fittings shall be specified in writing in advance of any work being carried out, and the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority must be obtained wherever these installations are to be visible or where ducts or other methods of concealment are proposed.
Condition : 4 - 4.	No pipes, ducts, wires and leaky feeders shall be fixed on the external faces of the building.
description: Installation of antenna and cabling to underground station
